title: Appointed as Assistant
original: The files that needed sorting have all been put away. I hope it'll help reduce some of your pressure, Doctor.

title: Talk 1
original: The atmosphere in here is duly soothing, much like my mountain forest. Doctor, you're free to come play when you're not busy.

title: Talk 2
original: I've talked a lot with the Medical Department's operators, and now I can understand what everyone's goal is. Doctor, allow me to rescue this land together with you.

title: Talk 3
original: This herbal pill... it's fine work. Myrrh's combined the properties of the medicinals and processed them in a special way. Hmm... I've never attempted such a manner of processing myself. In a little while, I'll see about learning from Myrrh.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Aid and sanctuary are unalike. The former cures the body, the latter saves the soul.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: To live is an endless cycle, reaping what one sows, all beings beholden to this. I imagine you can understand, having been through so much. Leaving your own memories behind in a different incarnation, constructing your own view of the outside world; that is the purpose of this life.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: These pills have not just the aroma of tea, but all sorts of flowers too. Many patients consider herbal pills bitter, so I've put my mind to diminishing that bitterness. I hope... the people of Rhodes Island won't dislike this flavor.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I very much agree with the tea here, its aroma calm, its true flavor apparent. As with tea, so with man. In this dwelling, those irrelevant rumors can be kept away; it's a rare place of respite.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor, the operators can have the dishes labelled with my name to eat, as well as some bottles of drinks I made myself. Everyone's been to truly tiresome lengths as of recent, and I wanted to do a thing or two to help alleviate their fatigue...

title: Idle
original: Are you tired? Rest well for a while. Don't worry; I'll protect you.

title: Onboard
original: It's nice to meet you; I'm Nine-Colored Deer. Hm? Are these motifs so beautiful? Th-Thank you... please, observe them as you like.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: May I go with you next time? I want to ensure everyone's safety.

title: Promotion 1
original: You've endorsed me? So I have been of help to you, then. Wonderful...

title: Promotion 2
original: The things I've learned may save many, but there remain yet more in need of aid. Doctor, can I still be more powerful than I am now?

title: Added to Squad
original: Worry not, I won't betray your trust.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Am I taking command? No problem.

title: Depart
original: Don't worry, I'll bring everyone home safely.

title: Begin Operation
original: Don't separate. We meet the battlefield now.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: I see them... an unknown enemy.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Are these new orders? Mm, acknowledged.

title: Deployment 1
original: This... is the chill of the battlefield.

title: Deployment 2
original: I'm ready.

title: In Battle 1
original: The mind is as truth, a mirror reflecting all ways.

title: In Battle 2
original: A thought leaving reality, delusion in all cases.

title: In Battle 3
original: Heaven and earth come alike, all beings come together.

title: In Battle 4
original: Everything has its way, per flame and per current.

title: 4-star Result
original: Mm... this battle was very smooth.

title: 3-star Result
original: Life is sincerely precious, but base and wicked life is punished in the end.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: You needn't be sad. Though there were slight faults, with a little more of a try, you will always succeed.

title: Operation Failure
original: If it has no power, no one should be shown that mercy.

title: Assigned to Facility
original: What a strange place. So much I've never seen before.

title: Tap
original: 'Kindness' is something not to be exploited, Doctor.

title: Trust Tap
original: Doctor, here's a scented tea for you. It'll perk you up.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: All in the past is like dream, like fire, like moons, like smoke. Like the reflection in a mirror, like the abyss of the void. But all things bloom and blossom in the wonderful years of life. Good work in the past year, Doctor, and may all things in the next one be auspicious and prosperous.

title: Greeting
original: You seem very energetic, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: See the way of all beings, and all takes on the true aspect. The aspect without self, the aspect without all life, and so all life's aspect is found in one, and one becomes with heaven and earth from the day they are born. What does your birthday symbolize, Doctor?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Blessed are those who give to the world. The blessings you give to the world will come back to you. May you continue to lead Rhodes Island forward, Doctor.
